content: {"like":["Unique premise among giant hero shows, focusing on two main characters traveling and protecting people.","Character development centered on Gentaro and Goro, avoiding large government teams.","Human villains using advanced tech, with aliens arriving later.","Twist that the sidekick Goro transforms into Iron King, not the lead agent.","Early episodes where Gentaro helps Iron King defeat bad guys before Iron King gains energy weapons.","Subverting typical Henshin Kaiju clichés.","Good picture quality with grindhouse-like grain and occasional funny darkening effect."],"dislike":[]}
